Model snapshot ToTable: customers, notifications, orders, order_items, payments, products (six).

PG 17 TRUNCATE: 'removes all rows from a set of tables'; CASCADE: 'Automatically truncate all tables that have foreign-key references to any of the named tables'; CONTINUE IDENTITY: 'Do not change the values of sequences. This is the default.' Model snapshot @stage-2: six ToTable (customers, notifications, orders, order_items, payments, products); all HasForeignKey targets are among them. Round-1 probe: the six-table TRUNCATE without CASCADE succeeds, so CASCADE adds none today.

Resetting in the test class's InitializeAsync runs regardless of how the previous test ended.
